insight.electric-fist-adept.why: Optional PB Lightning damage after an actual failed Electric Fist save; once-per-scene native immediate 5-foot movement without Opportunity Attacks.
insight.electric-fist-adept.player_outcome: after a failed Electric Fist save, you may deal lightning damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus; once per scene you may also move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks
